create_word_align_file: create a WordAlignFile with file_id, target, and decoded strings to compute WER, LER, and alignment path
get_partial_transcriptions: get partial transcriptions from a WordAlignFile by splitting target and decoded at specified word cut indices
reinsert_punctuation: reinsert punctuation into a normalized string by aligning it back to the original text using character-level alignment
load_word_align_file: load a JSON file of word alignment data into a list of WordAlignFile objects with computed alignment paths
get_align_index_path: compute a character-level alignment path between query and target strings using edlib with deletion, match, and substitution actions
